_comment: Branch protection for `main` — US-01.1.1 T-01.1.1.3. Production branch: every commit is a tagged release. Applied by scripts/apply-branch-protection.sh, asserted by scripts/verify-branch-protection.sh.
_strict_note: Same as develop: strict=true gives 'up to date before merging'; contexts empty until CI exists (US-01.4.x).
_enforce_admins_note: AC-4 — administrators cannot push directly to main.
_reviews_note: DEVIATION from AC-2/AC-3, same cause as develop. The branch strategy calls for TWO approvals on main once a team exists — main is the production branch, so it should be stricter than develop, not equal. Currently 0. See docs/project/13-branch-protection.md.
_linear_note: DELIBERATELY FALSE, unlike develop. The branch strategy merges release/* and hotfix/* into main with --no-ff to preserve release boundaries in history. A --no-ff merge creates a merge commit, which required_linear_history forbids. Setting this true would make every release merge fail. This corrects an internal contradiction in docs/project/10-branch-strategy.md, which listed 'Require linear history' for main while also mandating --no-ff merges.
